pyeongani.body: A water-drop character shaped like a calm ripple. Yangpyeong County already has Yangchun-i for the "Yang", so we made Pyeongan-i for the "pyeong". Side by side, the two of them spell Yangpyeong.

footer.studioBody: We build small AI web apps that lighten public-service work and everyday life in local communities.
footer.madeBy: 🛠️ Built by AI Admin App Studio
footer.disclaimer: Pyeongan-i is not an official Yangpyeong County mascot — it's an unofficial character made out of fondness for the area.
